evidence: One commenter tested algebra problems across several CAS tools and said Woxi was among the few to produce the expected answers.

evidence_sources.author: bobajeff
evidence_sources.excerpt: I've tried a few algebra problems with Sympy, Sage, Xcas, Maxima and Woxi. Of these only Sage, Maxima and Woxi were capable of giving the expected answers.

source_story_title: Show HN: Woxi - Open-source Mathematica / Wolfram Language reimplementation
